import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int h = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        BigInteger[][] dp = new BigInteger[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = BigInteger.ZERO;
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = BigInteger.ONE;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO;
                for (int m = 1; m <= i; m++) {
                    // term1: dp[m-1][j-1] * sum_{k=0}^{j-1} dp[i-m][k]
                    BigInteger sum1 = BigInteger.ZERO;
                    for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                        sum1 = sum1.add(dp[i - m][k]);
                    }
                    BigInteger term1 = dp[m - 1][j - 1].multiply(sum1);

                    // term2: dp[i-m][j-1] * sum_{k=0}^{j-2} dp[m-1][k]
                    BigInteger sum2 = BigInteger.ZERO;
                    for (int k = 0; k < j - 1; k++) {
                        sum2 = sum2.add(dp[m - 1][k]);
                    }
                    BigInteger term2 = dp[i - m][j - 1].multiply(sum2);

                    total = total.add(term1).add(term2);
                }
                dp[i][j] = total;
            }
        }

        BigInteger result = BigInteger.ZERO;
        for (int i = h; i <= n; i++) {
            result = result.add(dp[n][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
